detail.longDescription: I've been appointed Chair of the # IAPR 's Technical Committee 22 (#TC-22) on # Reproducible # Research in # Pattern # Recognition . I'll try to propose as many relevant activities around this topic as I can. Thank you Federico Bolelli for your excellent work as the previous chair! Bertrand Kerautret and Federico will join as vice-chairs. And needless to say, if you're interested in reproducible research and pattern recognition, you are more than welcome to join us too!
